tool.name: plasmidfinder_datamanager
tool.command:
database_dir='${output_file.extra_files_path}/plasmidfinder-db' && git clone #if str($database_select) == '2.2' --branch 'plasmidfinder-3.0.3' #elif str($database_select) != 'latest' --branch '$database_select' #end if 'https://bitbucket.org/genomicepidemiology/plasmidfinder_db.git' "\${database_dir}" && database_commit=\$(git -C "\${database_dir}" rev-parse --short=7 HEAD) && database_date=\$(TZ=UTC git -C "\${database_dir}" log -1 --format=%cd --date=format-local:%Y_%m_%d) && database_id="plasmidfinder_\${database_commit}_\${database_date}" &&
awk -F '\t' '!/^[[:space:]]*(#|$)/ && !seen[\$1]++ {print \$1}' "\${database_dir}/config" > database_prefixes.txt &&
if [ ! -s database_prefixes.txt ]; then echo 'No databases found in the database configuration' >&2; exit 1; fi && while IFS= read -r database_prefix; do kma index -i "\${database_dir}/\${database_prefix}.fsa" -o "\${database_dir}/\${database_prefix}" || exit \$?; done < database_prefixes.txt &&
installed_database=\$(awk -F '\t' -v database_id="\${database_id}" '\$1 == database_id {print \$2; exit}' '$installed_databases') && if [ -n "\${installed_database}" ]; then mkdir -p "\${installed_database}" && cp -R "\${database_dir}/." "\${installed_database}/" && echo "Reinstalled database \${database_id}; keeping the existing database entry." >&2 && printf '%s\n' '{"data_tables": {"plasmidfinder_database": []}}' > dm.json; else if [ -f "\${database_dir}/VERSION" ]; then database_version=\$(cat "\${database_dir}/VERSION"); elif [ -f "\${database_dir}/VERSION.txt" ]; then database_version=\$(cat "\${database_dir}/VERSION.txt"); else database_version='$database_select'; fi && ## Fill metadata placeholders after the selected database has been checked out. sed -e "s/@DATABASE_COMMIT@/\${database_commit}/g" -e "s/@DATABASE_DATE@/\${database_date}/g" -e "s/@DATABASE_VERSION@/\${database_version}/g" '$data_manager_json' > dm.json; fi

param.name: database_select
param.label: Database version
param.help: Choose a database version to download (default latest version)

tool.help: Download plasmidfinder database from the bitbucket repository: https://bitbucket.org/genomicepidemiology/plasmidfinder_db/src/master/
